en_US: Build your body from monster bones
The skull Bonesy woke up with. No frills.
An honest rib cage. Protects the emptiness inside.
Stacking poison: every hit adds a dose.
Shield of 15% HP at the start of combat
I built a %s in Bone Tribe! Can you build something worse?
Three skeleton rats are fighting over a petrified cheese. They stop and stare at you.
You tiptoe past. The cheese matters more than you do.
One rat decides you look petrified too. And tasty.
A witch offers a glowing bone in exchange for half your life. Accept or refuse?
The witch shrugs and tucks the bone into her hat. 'Your loss, sweetie.'
A chest creaks all by itself. It could be treasure. It could be a hungry mimic.
Treasure! The creak was just the hinge complaining about life.
The chest opens its mouth. It has teeth. Lots of teeth.
You leave the chest creaking alone. It looks offended.
A howl rolls through the tombs. The Crypt Wolf sniffs for your marrow, which you don't even have.
The wolf walks right by. The sarcophagus owner grumbles but lets you stay.
The sarcophagus lid creaks. The wolf grins. With every tooth.
Thick webs seal the corridor. Something with eight legs descends slowly, smiling with its fangs.
Your new legs know the way. The web becomes a shortcut, and the spider claps with four hands.
A Vampire Bat sleeps upside down, snoring softly. It smells of old blood.
Not a single bone creaks. A skeletal miracle.
Your knee pops. The bat wakes up. And calls its cousin.
The sand of an old tomb shifts. A curved tail rises, dripping something green.
A Corpse Bear hibernates on a pile of bones. Some of them look useful.
You rest a little to the sound of snoring. Strangely comforting.
Bones crack in the dark. Something is sniffing along your trail.
A gambling skeleton rattles knucklebone dice. 'Double or nothing on your bone dust?'
The dice land on six. The gambler nearly loses his jaw laughing.
The dice land on one. 'The house always wins, partner.'
'Coward!' he shouts, and goes back to betting with a rat.
A murky fountain bubbles. They say whoever drinks gets stronger… or softer.
The water runs down your ribs and hardens your bones. You feel sturdy.
The water tasted like swamp. Your bones go wobbly for a while.
Better not. You don't even have a stomach.
A coffin shakes. Inside, something knocks three times, politely.
Nobody home, just a fine bone waiting for a new owner.
Inside, only bone dust. Lots of bone dust.
It was two skeleton rats playing ghost. They don't find you funny.
The knocking stops. Then starts again, a little offended.
At the end of the crypt, on a throne of cheese and bones, the Rat King raises his crown. 'Kneel… ah, you have no knees.'
Hold the logo for demo mode
Rejection! Fire and water don't get along: %s fell off.
Fire breath on all enemies every 4 turns. Small monsters flee.
Shield of 20% HP at the start of each combat.
+6 attack. Strikes twice per turn, 60% damage each.
Avoids 15% of traps and strikes first on turn 1.
Summons 2 bone insects at the start of each combat.
Every 5 turns, a wave stuns all enemies.
Fire breath on all enemies every 3 turns.
Immune to the first hit of each combat; size doubles.
Revives once per run with 50% HP.
+8% to all stats per equipped family.
A pile of stones rises, grinding blue runes. The Forgotten Golem can't remember who it is, but it remembers how to crush.
The air grows hot. Huge bones uncoil in the dark and two eyes light up like embers. The Ancient Dragon woke up grumpy.
From the Dragon's ashes, three necks rise. Each head argues with the others about who gets to bite you first.
Your Bone Wyrm's fire called something ancient. The floor shakes. The crypt has one more floor.
The rats see your dragon skull, drop the cheese and flee squeaking. The cheese is yours. Still petrified.
The wolf flattens its ears, wags awkwardly and leaves a chewed bone as an offering.
You roar through the dragon skull. Whatever lurked in the dark suddenly remembers another appointment.
A Stone Turtle naps on an abandoned altar. The altar looks valuable. The turtle looks heavy.
A dark puddle bubbles. Two pincers rise out of it and go clack-clack, itching for a fight.
A wasp nest made of bones hums on the ceiling. A Bony Wasp comes out to see who's being noisy.
You buzz louder than they do. It works.
The whole swarm decides to walk you out. With stingers.
Run with your hands over your ears
A Giant Mantis prays before a tomb. When you arrive, it opens its eyes. And its blades.
You pray in silence. It finishes, bows, and leaves. You feel blessed.
You pray too loudly. The mantis considers it heresy.
Bone Grasshoppers sing in a choir. One of them goes off-key on purpose when it sees you.
The choir bows and plays you out with an encore. Musical experience gained.
Hooves echo down the hall. A Bony Centaur patrols the crypt as if it owned the place.
Hooves against hooves! You win by a vertebra. The centaur pays the bet, offended.
Challenge it to a race (Centaur Legs)
An Armored Beetle blocks the passage. It doesn't seem to want to move. Or be able to.
BONK! The shell cracks and the beetle runs off in its underwear. It leaves its stash behind.
An Ash Lizard warms itself on a brazier. Every time you blink, it seems a little bigger.
A Bony Cyclops guards the bridge with its single eye. It blinks. With the whole eye.
Eye to eye. Nobody blinks. After a long minute, the cyclops tears up, admits defeat and lets you pass.
Two shapes approach together. They argue quietly about who attacks first.
Sand trickles from a tunnel. Dune Scorpions dig in circles, looking for a bony dinner.
A Corpse Bear stuck its face in a wasp nest and is now very, very angry.
Three pairs of eyes light up in the dark. The crypt pack has learned to hunt together.
A procession of Skeleton Rats carries a cheese as if it were a king.
A cloud of bats screeches past. Two Vampire Bats stay behind, hungry.
Glowing eggs cover the wall. A Weaver Spider guards the nest, and another drops from the ceiling.
A rotten bridge spans a bottomless abyss. On the other side, something glitters.
The planks creak but hold. On the other side, a handful of bone dust.
A plank gives way. You dangle by your ribs until you climb back up.
You spread your wings and glide over the void, skipping three rooms straight to a forgotten chest.
The long way is safer. And more boring.
The corridor is flooded up to your ribs. Bubbles rise from somewhere below.
Your marine bones know how to swim. At the bottom, caught in the seaweed, a perfect bone.
The icy water softens your bones, but you find a few dust coins on the way.
A locked iron gate guards a chest. The lock is shaped like a grinning skull.
Slash, slash! The bars fall like twigs. The chest is all yours.
Click! The lock's skull giggles and opens.
The lock bites your finger. Literally.
An acid-green swamp bubbles. In the middle, a gleaming bone points at the ceiling.
Insects don't mind poison. You grab the bone and even take a sip as a souvenir.
It burns, but you reach the bone.
It burns, and the bone sinks before you get there.
A pit of embers blocks the way. The flames dance as if laughing at you.
The fire recognizes kin. You come out the other side glowing and stronger.
A perfect jump! Only slightly singed.
You landed right in the middle. It's fine. Everything's on fire, but it's fine.
A stone giant sleeps on a pile of bone dust. It snores like an earthquake.
You become a pebble among pebbles. The giant doesn't notice you filling your pockets.
Hide in your shell and steal (Beetle Shell)
It rolls over and keeps snoring. Mission accomplished.
The giant sneezes. You fly into the wall.
A skeleton cat blocks the way and refuses to move. It wants pets. Or a fight. Maybe both.
It purrs like a rattle. You feel strangely refreshed.
It was a fight. Definitely a fight.
A skeleton tailor offers adjustments: 'I can tighten those bones, you know. Only a small fee.'
'Don't complain when an arm falls off,' he grumbles.
A rusty crown rests on a velvet pillow. It whispers your name... wrong.
The crown squeezes your skull. You feel powerful and a little more fragile.
A skull on a shelf whispers: 'Take me with you? I promise not to talk much.'
It talks a lot. But it knows every shortcut and secret of the crypt.
Three identical chests stand in a row. One of them is breathing.
The ceiling creaks and starts to collapse! Something glitters in the rubble.
Boing, boing, boing! You bounce between the stones and grab the shiny thing too.
Floor plates bear the marks of crushed bones. Someone clearly didn't read the sign.
A golden sarcophagus. A sign warns: DO NOT OPEN. Another, smaller sign: seriously.
Inside, a rare bone wrapped in silk.
Gold coins turn into bone dust in your hand. Still worth it.
A curse flies out and bites your ribs. You were warned.
A skeleton hugs a chest tightly. It's already dead, but it still won't let go.
After a lot of effort, the chest is yours. The skeleton looks relieved.
Pry it loose finger by finger
The Wandering Gravedigger sells used bones: 'Seven-day warranty or your skull back.'
A tiny bony pawnshop accepts anything. 'I sell, I buy, I trade. Mostly sell.'
A marrow soup vendor stirs a cauldron. 'Warms the bones, dearie!'
A hooded merchant opens his coat. Inside, only rare bones. 'Don't ask where they came from.'
A skeleton banker offers interest: hand over your dust now and get more back... maybe.
The investment pays off! The banker returns it with interest and a wink.
'The bone market crashed,' he says, pocketing your dust.
A skeleton trapped in a cage begs for help. Freeing it costs bone dust, but it will fight by your side.
The cage opens. 'Thanks, boss! I'll handle the hitting.'
Snip! The chains fall for free. The skeleton hugs your pincer, moved.
A skeleton squire lost its knight. 'Can I follow you? I'll carry things!'
It doesn't carry anything, but it bashes with its shield very enthusiastically.
A ghost hound wags its see-through tail. It seems to have lost its owner some three hundred years ago.
The hound howls with joy and starts biting your enemies' ankles.
The altar accepts one of your bones and returns one from another family, without saying which.
An altar demands blood. You have no blood. It'll take life instead.
The altar drinks and returns strength. Your blows grow heavier.
A moonlit altar turns bone dust into stronger bones.
A campfire of blue candles: heal 30% of your HP or upgrade a bone by one level.
A quiet ossuary full of cozy niches. A great place for a nap.
You meditate on the nature of bones. Conclusion: they're great.
A shrine of candles that never go out. The wax drips in the shape of bones.
The candle whispers 'thank you' and turns into bone dust in your hand.
Your reflection in the lake has one more bone. It reaches out its hand.
The water chills you to the marrow. When you pull your hand back, it holds a bone that wasn't there before.
The reflection shrugs and goes back to being just you.
A fortune-telling skull shuffles bone cards. 'One card. Just one.'
The Tower of Bones: your body grows stronger.
The Wheel of Dust: riches ahead!
The Wise Skeleton: you learn something new.
A comet of bones streaks across the crypt ceiling. Make a wish!
Your nimble legs leap over the trap just in time!
Trap! Something snaps, drops and hits you square on.
Bone dust becomes permanent strength for your next attempt.
Bring one companion per run. They level up with bone dust.
15% chance to fetch an extra bone after each combat.
Heals 8% of Bonesy's HP every 3 turns.
Once per run, upgrades a bone from common to rare.
Find her at a candle shrine in the crypt, or unlock her in the shop.
Reward for day 7 of the welcome bonus.
Four slots: amulet, ring, cloak and lantern. Upgrade with bone dust.
%d of %d objects on the shelf. Duplicates earn stars.
%d of %d bones found. Tap a bone to start your run with it.
Rare and legendary bones need a Rare starting bone token (Shop).
If you die, he steals your best bone and wears it.
He hasn't stolen anything from you. Yet.
A hooded figure blocks the corridor. It's the Bone Hunter, wearing what he stole from you: %s. 'Came to take it back?'
You retreat into the shadows. The Hunter chuckles: 'Next time, then.'
The Hunter falls and returns your %s, now +%d!
The Hunter has %d of your bones
Choose a common bone to become rare.
+8% dust, +3% bone chance, more rare events
Full set: one guaranteed chest every 10 floors
Reveals the type of the next event
3% shield at the start of combat
Your name in the credits. Thank you!
Counts days you log in, not consecutive days. Day 7 is the best!
A 28-day cycle that restarts. Days 7, 14 and 21 are special; day 28 gives a curiosity.
Visual styles for every bone. They show on the Creature Card!
Diamonds drop from bosses, calendars and ads. Buying only speeds things up.
Start your next run with a rare bone of your choice (Collection).
One Cabinet of Curiosities item, rare or better.
Unlocks Lumi before you find her in the game.
Simulated purchases in this prototype: nothing is charged.
30 days: 30 diamonds and 300 dust per day, 1 free revive per day and 1 rare chest per week.
No more ads between runs and +10% bone dust forever. Rewarded ads stay optional.
Exclusive Founder Bonesy skin and your name in the credits.
